identitySignals: The name matches: the agenda says 'A and B Mechanical, Inc.' and the company's website and the Northern California Mechanical Contractors Association (NCMCA) listing use 'A&B Mechanical Inc.'
The location matches: the website gives 2252 Railroad Ave, Livermore, CA 94550, and the agenda says Livermore, CA.
The trade matches: the company is a licensed commercial HVAC and boiler contractor (CSLB license 740508), and OUSD hired it for a school boiler replacement project.
Third-party listings (Blue Book, Yahoo Local) show the same Livermore business with the same website, abmechanical.com.
research.notes: I did not check the California Secretary of State or SAM.gov registries, so the entity number and UEI are null. A nonprofit EIN does not apply. The contact page lists mostly named staff emails and a garbled 'General Information' address, so I left the email null instead of guessing. The BuildZoom listing shows a Hayward address for the same license, which I did not use. I found no page that mentions OUSD directly, so identity rests on the matching name, city and trade.

profile.summary: A&B Mechanical is a union-based, licensed and bonded heating, air conditioning and refrigeration (HVAC/R) contractor in Livermore, California. It designs, installs and maintains commercial and industrial HVAC and boiler systems for customers around the Bay Area. It offers 24/7 on-call service.

review.notes: The company's contact and About pages give the name A&B Mechanical Inc., the address 2252 Railroad Ave in Livermore, the main number 1-866-502-4822 and CSLB license 740508, and they describe a union-based, licensed and bonded HVAC/R contractor in the Bay Area with 24/7 on-call service. The site also links to an HVAC/R & Boiler Compliance service page, and school-district prequalified-contractor lists show the same Livermore firm and license, which fits OUSD's boiler replacement contract. The summary is neutral, all non-null fields are supported, and the email was correctly left null instead of using staff emails.
